records.generatedCopy: Jev's three primitives do not share one uncertainty contract: Choice and Score return confidence plus distributions, while Noul returns a yes probability. This guide combines them into one versioned policy with named ask/review paths, fail-closed API behavior, and an eight-case test matrix. It keeps refunds, deletions, deployments, and publication behind deterministic checks and exact confirmation.
